name: Textiles & Weaves
description: Exquisite handwoven silks, tie-dyes, block prints, and traditional looms from across India.

name: Pottery & Ceramics
description: Ancient terracotta, blue glaze pottery, and black clay earthenware crafted by master potters.

name: Paintings & Folk Art
description: Indigenous tribal canvas, scroll paintings, and sacred folk art traditions passed through generations.

name: Jewellery
description: Traditional Kundan, Meenakari, silver filigree, and tribal brass ornament heritage.

name: Bamboo & Cane
description: Eco-conscious handcrafted bamboo basketry, furniture, and cane weaves from North-East India.

name: Woodcraft
description: Intricate sandalwood carving, rosewood inlay work, and traditional wooden architectural decor.

name: Metal Craft
description: Lost-wax Dhokra casting, brassware, Bidriware silver inlay, and bell-metal casting.

name: Stone Carving
description: Sculptural marble inlay, soapstone carving, and granite temple craft architecture.

name: Leather Craft
description: Traditional Mojari footwear, Kolhapuri chappals, and hand-embossed leather artifacts.

name: Embroidery
description: Intricate needlework traditions including Chikankari, Phulkari, Kantha, and Toda embroidery.

name: Home Decor
description: Handmade wall hangings, brass lamps, papier-mâché vases, and artisan living space accents.

name: Toys & Dolls
description: Lacquerware wooden toys, Kondapalli wooden figurines, and eco-friendly heritage playcraft.

name: Musical Instruments
description: Handcrafted sitars, veenas, dhols, ektaras, and folk musical instruments made by master craftsmen.

name: Handloom
description: Authentic handloom sarees, dupattas, stoles, and yardage woven on traditional pit looms.

name: Eco-Friendly Crafts
description: Sustainable Sikki grass, coconut shell art, jute weaves, and zero-waste natural craft innovations.
